name: Module Input
description: Asks the policy sets adding this module for a value (cfbs input).

parameters.name: variable_name
parameters.label: Variable name
parameters.help: Lowercase letters and _ only (cfbs). Once published, renaming it makes everyone using the module answer again.

parameters.name: input_label
parameters.label: Input label
parameters.help: What people adding the module see, e.g. “Listen port”.

parameters.name: question
parameters.label: Question
parameters.help: Asked when the module is added, e.g. “Which port should the app listen on?”.

value_sources.label: Text
value_sources.help: One value, e.g. a port or a hostname.

parameters.name: default
parameters.label: Default
parameters.help: Offered as the answer, and used when there's none. Without one, the question must be answered, so adding the module unattended fails.

value_sources.label: List
value_sources.help: Any number of values, each asked with the question, e.g. users to remove. Without answers, an empty list.

value_sources.label: Table
value_sources.help: Rows of named values, e.g. a name and a path per site: $(vars.sites[0][name]). Without answers, no rows.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.label: Fields
parameters.help: One per line, key: question (= default), e.g. root: Document root? = /var/www/html. Keys take lowercase letters, digits and _.
